desc: Long tasks span sessions, and information is lost at every boundary unless recorded.
objectives: Identify what is lost between sessions.

title: Multi-Session Handoff — The Handoff Note
desc: A short structured note lets the next session resume in minutes.
objectives: List the sections of a handoff note.
Leave the repository in a clean state.
builderEn: [{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Multi-Session Handoff — The Handoff Note","textKn":"Multi-Session Handoff — The Handoff Note","level":"H1"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Lesson Info","headingKn":"Lesson ಮಾಹಿತಿ","bodyEn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 minutes · Part 2 of 3 in Multi-Session Handoff","bodyKn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳು · Part 2 of 3"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Sections","headingKn":"ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು","bodyEn":"Goal, done, next step, blockers, decisions with reasons, how to run the checks, and known risks.","bodyKn":"ಗುರಿ, ಮುಗಿದದ್ದು, ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂತ, ತಡೆಗಳು, ಕಾರಣ ಸಹಿತ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ, ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುವುದು, ತಿಳಿದ ಅಪಾಯ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Clean State","headingKn":"ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ","bodyEn":"Commit or stash work in progress and make sure the build and tests run, so the next session does not start by debugging.","bodyKn":"ಪ್ರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕೆಲಸ commit ಅಥವಾ stash ಮಾಡಿ, ಬಿಲ್ಡ್ ಮತ್ತು tests ಚಲಿಸುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿ; ಮುಂದಿನ ಸೆಷನ್ debugging ನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸಬಾರದು."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Key Takeaways","headingKn":"ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳು","bodyEn":"• Note: goal, done, next, blockers, decisions, checks.\n• Leave a clean, runnable repo.","bodyKn":"• ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿ: ಗುರಿ, ಮುಗಿದದ್ದು, ಮುಂದೆ, ತಡೆ, ನಿರ್ಧಾರ.\n• ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ ರೆಪೊ."}},{"type":"quiz","data":{"questions":[{"q":"Include in the note:","qKn":"ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಏನಿರಬೇಕು?","opts":["Next step and blockers","Only a greeting","Nothing","Jokes"],"optsKn":["ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂತ ಮತ್ತು ತಡೆ","ಶುಭಾಶಯ ಮಾತ್ರ","ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ","ಹಾಸ್ಯ"],"correct":0},{"q":"Repo state at handoff:","qKn":"ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ರೆಪೊ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ:","opts":["Clean and runnable","Broken","Empty","Unknown"],"optsKn":["ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ ಮತ್ತು ಚಲಿಸುವ","ಮುರಿದ","ಖಾಲಿ","ಅಜ್ಞಾತ"],"correct":0},{"q":"Why include decisions with reasons?","qKn":"ಕಾರಣ ಸಹಿತ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಏಕೆ?","opts":["To avoid contradicting them","To lengthen","For style","No reason"],"optsKn":["ವಿರೋಧಿಸದಿರಲು","ಉದ್ದ","ಶೈಲಿ","ಕಾರಣವಿಲ್ಲ"],"correct":0}]}}]

title: Multi-Session Handoff — Verifying a Handoff
desc: Test a handoff by having a fresh session resume from the note alone.
objectives: Improve the note from what the fresh session missed.
